entries.a428bfe714b90e88: It is the group's core business and its only reportable segment. Consolidated subsidiaries Marukyu, Marukyo, Marumiya Store and others operate supermarkets in 10 prefectures from Yamaguchi Prefecture to Kagoshima Prefecture, mainly selling fresh food, as well as processed foods, prepared foods, daily sundries and others. As of the end of February 2026, the total number of stores was 281, and operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥277,290 million. The RPG Miyazaki Logistics Center, the group's shared logistics base, is located in Miyazaki City, Miyazaki Prefecture.

entries.bc3508f83f4bc576: It is operated by consolidated subsidiary Marukyo Co., Ltd. Mainly in Fukuoka Prefecture, it sells fresh food, general foodstuffs and daily sundries in Nagasaki, Saga, Oita and Kumamoto prefectures. As of the end of February 2026, it had 82 stores. Likewise, consolidated subsidiary Aoki Shoji Co., Ltd. acts as a secondary food wholesaler, purchasing general foodstuffs sold at Marukyo stores.
entries.cae22f593261415b: This is a business not included in the reportable segments. Consolidated subsidiary RPG Insurance Service Co., Ltd. acts as an agent for non-life and life insurance for individuals and corporations. Tomura Foods Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells processed meat products and seasonings sold at the group's stores and stores of the same format, and Tomura Bokujo Co., Ltd. produces and processes fattened cattle. In addition, Marukyu Co., Ltd. operates a sports club business as a franchise member. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥907 million.
